run.Original_Project_description: We searched for specific bacterial species and gene functions involved in the pathogenesis of classical Western-type multiple sclerosis (CMS) by analyzing the gut microbial metagenomic gene sequence data of 62 relapsing-remitting CMS patients; 15 secondary progressive CMS patients; 21 atypical MS patients; 20 neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder patients; and 55 age-matched healthy controls. We identified candidates of specific bacterial species and gene functions that are involved in the development and progression of MS.
